$comment: Ironman account types, used by plugins/modes/Ironman.plugin.js (docs/ironman.md). `varbit` is the `ironman` varbit's value (1777; the cache's enum 859 names them), `icon` the mod-icon shown before the name in chat, `rank` orders the modes for downgrades, `armour` is what Adam hands out. Each message notes where it comes from: the rsprox capture database (https://rsprox.net/database), the OSRS Wiki, or ours where neither has it.

setup.$comment: The setup interface (ironman_setup 890) and its confirmation (popupoverlay 289 in 890:29, script 4212), as captured on Tutorial Island. The varps are sent before it opens. Buttons 21-27 are modes 0-6 in the order the interface's script 519 lays them out (None, Ironman, Ultimate, Hardcore, then the three group modes).

tradeSelf.text: You are an Ironman. You stand alone.

pickup.text: You're an Ironman, so you can't take items that other players have dropped.

sharedKill.text: As an Ironman, you don't get loot if other players helped you kill the monster.

killCredit.text: As an Ironman, you might not receive kill-credit for this monster.

grandExchange.text: As an Ironman, you cannot use the Grand Exchange.

shopStock.text: As an Ironman, you can only buy the shop's own stock.

presets.text: As an Ironman, you cannot use presets.

ultimateBank.text: As an Ultimate Ironman, you cannot use the bank.

hardcoreDeath.text: You have fallen as a Hardcore Ironman. You are now a standard Ironman.
